data.value: This is the final confirmation. All secret bookmarks will be deleted permanently and cannot be restored from this application without another copy. Continue?

data.name: Confirm_ResetSecretMasterPasswordMessage
data.value: Resetting the master password will permanently delete all secret bookmarks and remove the old secret profile. This does not recover forgotten data. You will be able to set a new master password later.

data.name: Confirm_DeleteSyncRemoteProblemMessage
data.value: This will delete one problematic sync file from the WebDAV folder. If that file actually belongs to another device, a newer app version, or a not-yet-synchronized change, deleting it may permanently lose that remote data. Stranichnik cannot undo this operation. Use it only when you are sure the remote file is corrupted or no longer needed.
